channel.title: RealHunt Research
channel.description: Data and plain-English guides on cheap homes around the world, from the homes on RealHunt.

item.title: The 10 best home deals this week: 9 to 16 November 2026
item.description: The 10 highest-scored homes that passed our check from 9 to 16 November 2026, in Spain and Portugal, priced from €63,000 to €159,900.

item.title: The 10 best home deals this week: 31 October to 7 November 2026
item.description: The 10 highest-scored homes that passed our check from 31 October to 7 November 2026, in Spain, Italy and Japan, priced from €7,400 to €178,000.

item.title: Top 10 home deals near Miami under $300,000 in good neighbourhoods
item.description: We read 8,300 listings around Miami and kept the 10 best 2 and 3-bedroom homes under $300,000 in Doral, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Plantation, Miramar and Kendall, with what they really cost each month.

item.title: How to spot a property scam when you buy a house abroad
item.description: The warning signs we see in cheap-house listings, and six checks that stop most scams before you send any money.

item.title: What to check when you visit a cheap house: a 20-point checklist
item.description: Roof, damp, water, power, access, paperwork: the things that turn a cheap house into an expensive one, and how to check them in one visit.

item.title: Bali, Phuket, Tulum or Batumi? 400 new builds scored side by side
item.description: Median price, price per m², distance to the sea and facilities for 400 new-build projects. Batumi is the cheapest by far; Tulum is the furthest from the beach.

item.title: Best new builds in Bali, scored: price, beach and facilities (2026)
item.description: We scored the 100 projects in our Bali Top 100 from 0 to 100 on price, beach, facilities and seven more things. Median price €153,555; 41 are within 1 km of the sea.

item.title: Best new builds in Phuket, scored: price, beach and facilities (2026)
item.description: We scored the 100 projects in our Phuket Top 100 from 0 to 100 on price, beach, facilities and seven more things. Median price €159,134; 50 are within 1 km of the sea.

item.title: Best new builds in Tulum, scored: price, beach and facilities (2026)
item.description: We scored the 100 projects in our Tulum Top 100 from 0 to 100 on price, beach, facilities and seven more things. Median price €146,927; 6 are within 1 km of the sea.

item.title: Best new builds in Batumi, scored: price, beach and facilities (2026)
item.description: We scored the 100 projects in our Batumi Top 100 from 0 to 100 on price, beach, facilities and seven more things. Median price €48,630; 73 are within 1 km of the sea.

item.title: What €50,000 Buys in 2026: 140 Checked Homes, Country by Country
item.description: We sorted every home on RealHunt by price. 46 of 140 cost €50,000 or less, and almost all of them are in three countries.

item.title: How Many Months of Rent Would Buy You a Whole House?
item.description: We divided the median price of homes on RealHunt by three monthly rents. At €1,200 a month, a typical Italian village house costs less than three years of rent.

item.title: Cheap Houses in Sweden: What €22,000 to €99,000 Gets You
item.description: 41 Swedish homes under €100,000, most of them red wooden houses on big plots near a lake. Where they are, what they cost to buy, and what to check.

item.title: Not Every Cheap House in Japan Is an Abandoned Akiya
item.description: Stories about free houses in Japan usually show wrecks. These 18 homes start at €18,400 and you could move into them.

item.title: Italian Homes Near the Sea for Under €50,000: Where They Actually Are
item.description: Cheap Italian houses are usually in inland hill towns. A few are close to the water. Here is where they are and what the catch is.

item.title: Move-In-Ready Houses in the US for Around $100,000
item.description: We published 13 US homes that cost under €100,000 and do not need gutting. They start at $75,000. Here is where they are.

item.title: Why We Say No to Most Cheap Houses
item.description: A cheap house that needs €80,000 of work is not a cheap house. The rule we use to decide what goes on RealHunt, and why we turn most listings down.
